story_overview: From a military encampment, Seo-jun arrives at the Royal Courtyard and formally greets Hae-won. Tense conversations unfold within the palace between Seo-jun, the official Min-jun, and So-hee, culminating in So-hee's somber reflection in her chambers.

video_prompts:
Jin-woo: Young man with long, dark, messy hair, wearing a blue headband and silver chest plate over a maroon-and-blue tunic
Ji-ho: Man wearing a full-length, coarse-spun beige robe and a simple black cloth headband across his forehead
Seo-jun: Man with long, curly dark hair and a goatee, wearing brown studded leather armor over an ornate red and gold tunic

Seo-jun, wearing the studded leather armor and the ornate black headband, stares forward as his expression becomes stern and intense. Jin-woo shifts his weight slightly to his right, and Ji-ho watches from just behind them.
